## What's Changed
* Heart of Tarasque and Desolator by @ciaabcdefg in https://github.com/mc-buffdog/op-enchants-and-more/pull/18

### New enchantments
- **Desolator:** lowers target armor and magical protection and grants extra damage with each player kill
- **Heart of Tarasque:** increases maximum HP and grants a healing status effect when all items in armor slots are enchanted with it

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/mc-buffdog/op-enchants-and-more/compare/v0.6.0-26.1.2...v0.7.0-26.1.2

releases.notes:
## What's Changed
* Feature/attribute fix by @ciaabcdefg in https://github.com/mc-buffdog/op-enchants-and-more/pull/13
* Feature/greater enchantments 2 by @ciaabcdefg in https://github.com/mc-buffdog/op-enchants-and-more/pull/14
* Greater Enchantments phase 2 by @ciaabcdefg in https://github.com/mc-buffdog/op-enchants-and-more/pull/15
* Nerf Cleave range and angle by @ciaabcdefg in https://github.com/mc-buffdog/op-enchants-and-more/pull/16
* Smelting enchantment by @ciaabcdefg in https://github.com/mc-buffdog/op-enchants-and-more/pull/17

### Enchantment attributes
Due to a problem with offhand weapons benefiting from mainhand enchantments, I've decided not to use attributes to calculate their effects. Attributes are still in the registry to minimize damage that could happen with removing attributes from the registry.

### Greater enchantments (phase 2)
- Greater Protection
- Greater Fortune

### New enchantment: Smelting
**Smelting** can be enchanted on pickaxes and shovels, which drops a block's smelted result when mined.

### Enchantment balancing
**Cleave** range and angle have been nerfed due to some feedback from my friends. Helps prevent accidental friendly-fire with players and mobs as well, especially with Coup de Grâce-enchanted weapons.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/mc-buffdog/op-enchants-and-more/compare/v0.5.3-26.1.2...v0.6.0-26.1.2
